mostWorthwhile.text: Supplying the mitochondrion with oxygen was most worthwhile: the illustration plan separates oxygen’s role as an electron acceptor from food’s energy contribution and shows how the hydrogen-ion gradient drives ATP production.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the pump was a straightforward fitting step, though separating installation from operation helped clarify what ATP does.

surprise.text: The final protein-making picture explicitly keeps pyruvate on the fuel route rather than putting it into the protein chain, making that distinction clearer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although combining a mitochondrial ATP supply directly with ribosomes abstracts away how ATP reaches and supports the machinery.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these cellular processes connect to tissues and organs; the constructions made useful distinctions without requiring specialist anatomy.
